# Safety-Critical Controller Synthesis with Reduced-Order Models

> [!info] Cohen, Max H.; Csomay-Shanklin, Noel; Compton, William D.; Molnar, Tamas G.; Ames, Aaron D. · 2025 · L-CSS / ACC 2025 — **my paper**

## Abstract
Reduced-order models (ROMs) provide lower di- Full Order Model Safety-Critical Control mensional representations of complex systems, capturing their of Full Order Model salient features while simplifying control design. Building on previous work, this paper presents an overarching framework for the integration of ROMs and control barrier functions, enabling the use of simplified models to construct safety-critical controllers while providing safety guarantees for complex full- order models.
